result.title: The Elephant in the Question: Unified Models Picture the Concepts Behind Their Answers
result.summary: Visualizing intermediate representations could help us inspect the reasoning steps underlying a model output. Unified multimodal models offer this opportunity by combining understanding and generation in one architecture. Their image generators can access representations formed while processing text. We introduce the V-lens, which uses this connection to visualize a chosen token's hidden state without training a decoder. Across four diffusion-based and two purely autoregressive unified models, the resulting images reveal key intermediate concepts that connect a question to its answer even when the concepts are never named explicitly. Controlled tests show how this content changes with context, token position, and depth. We then introduce lens tuning, which supervises selected hidden states with pictures through the V-lens. Across BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0, the rate of correct visualizations of pronoun referents rises from 2-11% to 86-94%. Surprisingly, such visual supervision also improves text answers without supervising the answer tokens directly. Code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/V-lens.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 V-lens，无需训练解码器，借助统一多模态模型的图像生成器把指定 token 的隐藏状态可视化为图像，并在四个 diffusion 与两个纯自回归统一模型上考察概念内容随上下文、token 位置和深度的变化；进一步提出 lens tuning，用图像监督选定隐状态，使代词指代的可视化正确率从 2–11% 升至 86–94%，且文本答案也同步改善。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作直接检验内部状态是否保留问题与答案之间的关键概念，其对位置、深度的受控分析可供 LVR 表示诊断核查；lens tuning 以视觉监督隐状态并改变文本输出，构成 latent 内容贡献分配与状态监督的具体线索，但并非推理期 latent 生成方法。
